label: PF Backlog 42
title: Backend-first changes required by the dashboard build (convention + dual-backlog tracking)
body: Convention (owner, discovery P13): when the dashboard needs a backend capability (new API endpoint, webhook/email channel, per-user/tenant capacity context, tenant model, script parameters, control operations, PWA support, etc.), the backend change/design is implemented FIRST in the pipeline, then consumed by the dashboard. Every such change gets a linked backlog item in BOTH scopes - this product_forge item (backend) and a ProductForge-Dashboard project item (dashboard UI) - cross-linked by id for tracking/monitoring on both sides. Applies for the whole dashboard build.
